description: Probes of TLS on tunnel connections at the relay, Relay Specification v0 (draft), RELAY-v0.md sections 4.1 and 4.2, for the live test. Each case is a control connection that a test tool opens to relay.host and relay.port with: version (the highest TLS version it offers), groups (the key exchange groups it offers, by their names in the IANA TLS Supported Groups registry), alpn (the protocols it offers), certificate (tunnel: a tunnel certificate of the test installation with an Ed25519 key; tunnel-p256: one with a P-256 key; none; self-signed: a self-signed certificate with the subject alternative name of a tunnel certificate of the test installation; unpaired: a tunnel certificate of an installation the tool unpaired), and resume (it first opens an accepted connection and then offers to resume its session). After the handshake it sends hello. Accepted: the handshake completes with TLS 1.3, X25519MLKEM768 and hm-tunnel/1, without resumption, and the relay answers hello with hello-ack. Refused: the handshake fails, or the relay closes the connection without sending a frame. The tool authenticates the relay by its pins, closes each accepted connection before the next probe and spaces its probes within the RECOMMENDED limits of section 4.8; it probes unpaired more than 60 seconds after the unpairing, the time instances have to refuse a certificate on the denylist (section 4). Checked by the tests in relay/ against a server configured as in section 4.2.

cases.why: TLS 1.3, X25519MLKEM768, hm-tunnel/1 and the Ed25519 tunnel certificate
X25519 offered besides X25519MLKEM768: the relay selects X25519MLKEM768
h2 offered before hm-tunnel/1: the relay selects hm-tunnel/1
after an accepted connection the client offers to resume its session: the relay does not resume, because it issues no session ticket or ignores the one offered
TLS 1.2 at most, with x25519 besides X25519MLKEM768, which TLS 1.2 cannot use
a self-signed certificate with the SPIFFE ID of the test installation
the tunnel certificate of an installation unpaired during the run
